intro.what: Kyoto: Godzilla faces the camera head and shoulders and roars as debris flies, then black smoke billows up around him (0:47:20.8 to 0:47:25.8, one shot).

loop.what: Kyoto: wide shot of Godzilla advancing behind a five-story pagoda past a temple, onlookers in the foreground, small explosions and a helicopter at right (0:44:39.0 to 0:44:54.0, one continuous shot).

lock.what: Kyoto: Godzilla roars over the top of a white office block, then tears through it in a burst of debris (0:48:19.4 to 0:48:22.9, a run of two shots).

baby.what: Baby Godzilla in his pen at the research facility cries out with his mouth wide open, then turns to the people at the bars (1:00:13.7 to 1:00:18.2, one shot).

jackpot.what: First battle: Godzilla fires his blue atomic ray, then from behind him the ray strikes Mechagodzilla in a red burst (0:37:03.6 to 0:37:06.8, a run of two shots).

super.what: Climax at Makuhari: Godzilla glows and fires his red spiral ray, the ray streaks across, and Super Mechagodzilla is engulfed in a huge fireball (1:35:26.8 to 1:35:31.1, a run of three shots).

won.what: Ending: wide night shot of Godzilla wading out to sea with Baby swimming beside him while three people watch from the beach (1:44:52.0 to 1:44:58.0, one shot).

lost.what: First battle: Godzilla lies felled in the smoke, then Mechagodzilla hovers over his fallen body (0:38:30.5 to 0:38:35.4, a run of two shots).

music.what: Opening titles: Akira Ifukube's main title music, rhythmic orchestral brass chords with cymbal and percussion, no dialogue or effects (0:03:30.15 to 0:03:43.40, loops cleanly).

rage.what: Revived Godzilla gives a short isolated roar in close-up at Makuhari (1:40:43.3), silence before and after.

angry.what: Revived Godzilla, a silhouette in fire and smoke, lets out a long full roar out of near silence (1:40:13.2).

lock.what: Outside Kyoto a shell explodes in the smoke around Godzilla, one heavy blast that decays to quiet (0:44:35.4).

baby.what: Newly hatched Baby Godzilla gives a short cry in the dark lab (0:27:35.4), silence before and after.

jackpot.what: Godzilla's atomic ray fires at Mechagodzilla, a rushing blast that swells and falls back, score underneath (0:37:03.9).

super.what: Super Mechagodzilla's salvo fires over burning Makuhari, a huge blast out of silence that rolls off (1:26:34.5).

won.what: Godzilla calls out to Baby at their night reunion by the bay, soft score underneath (1:42:47.6).

lost.what: Godzilla, felled by Mechagodzilla, gives a low pained cry from the ground in the smoke (0:38:31.8).
